'''Energy binders''' were a form of wrist restraints that were used by [[Lemo and Sanda's gang]]. In order to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] their prisoners, [[Lemo]] and [[Sanda]] would hang individuals from energy binders. The uncomfortable position would eventually encourage the prisoners to talk. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were once subjected to this action, but they were able to escape.
